fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-100, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.

fields.name: arcana
fields.description: Filter by arcana type. Major arcana (0-21) represents life lessons and spiritual themes. Minor arcana (Ace-King in 4 suits) represents daily situations and practical matters.

fields.name: suit
fields.description: Filter minor arcana by suit. Cups=emotions/relationships, Wands=creativity/passion, Swords=intellect/conflict, Pentacles=material/finances. Only applies to minor arcana cards.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Filter by card number. Major Arcana: 0 (The Fool) through 21 (The World). Minor Arcana: 1 (Ace) through 14 (King). Combine with arcana or suit filters for precise results.
